## DPStyleARWebLive.stop() method

Stop all StyleAR modules and release associated resources. This method cleanly shuts down both the processing and camera modules, releasing all allocated resources and terminating the virtual try-on session.

**Signature:**

```typescript
stop(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

A promise that resolves when all modules have been stopped.
